entries.en: Hello, my name is Arif Iqbal, and this is WNS News.
entries.ro: Bună ziua, sunt Arif Iqbal, și aceasta e WNS News.

entries.en: We return to this week's shocking story – the cyberpsycho attack on Night City Mayor Lucius Rhyne.
entries.ro: Revenim la povestea șocantă a săptămânii – atacul cyberpsycho asupra primarului Lucius Rhyne din Night City.

entries.en: The crazed assailant attacked the mayor during a press conference but, fortunately, was stopped by NCPD Detective River Ward before the worst could happen.
entries.ro: Nebunul a atacat primarul la o conferință de presă, dar, din fericire, detectivul NCPD River Ward l-a oprit înainte să fie și mai rău.

entries.en: Celebrated by the press as "super cop", today Ward was given the Medal of Merit by the mayor.
entries.ro: Botezat de presă „super polițist”, Ward a primit azi Medalia de Merit de la primar.

entries.en: What could have been a horrible tragedy may be a blessing in disguise for the mayor who seeks another term in the upcoming mayoral election.
entries.ro: Ce putea fi o tragedie groaznică s-ar putea dovedi un noroc pentru primarul care vrea un nou mandat în alegerile locale viitoare.

entries.en: According to the latest polls in wake of the attack, Rhyne's lead over his opponent, Jefferson Peralez, has jumped from 12 to 19 percentage points.
entries.ro: Potrivit ultimelor sondaje de după atac, avansul lui Rhyne față de Jefferson Peralez a crescut de la 12 la 19 puncte procentuale.

entries.en: We'll be right back with more local news.
entries.ro: Revenim imediat cu mai multe știri locale.
